assessment: The process of termination in Archael species is poorly defined despite a high relation to eukaryotes and a shared homology of termination factors. In this study, the authors defined key features that drive termination to include an upstream uridine track that is bound by the CPSF ribonuclease through KH RNA binding domains not present in the CSPF counterparts. This work provides fundamental mechanistic insight into the conserved manner of termination in the archael species.
